page_evidence.observation: The abstract spans modulation analysis, network planning, and constellation optimization with named algorithms.
BER-SNR curves compare QPSK, 8QAM, and 16QAM under a common threshold.
A convergence curve is paired with a map of the selected optical network.
A second topology optimization repeats the convergence-plus-map structure.
Original and optimized 8QAM and 16QAM constellations are shown as aligned panels.
BER curves compare the original and proposed QAM designs.
The appendix shows only a short plotting fragment and not a complete runnable package.

abstract_structure.observation: Summarize modulation, graph optimization, shortest path, and constellation redesign in the same order as the tasks.

model_chain.observation: Quantify BER-SNR behavior for standard QPSK and QAM schemes.
Represent the optical transport network as a graph and optimize topology value with genetic search and TSP ideas.
Use Dijkstra shortest paths inside the network evaluation.
Move constellation points to improve the SNR tolerance threshold.

validation_chain.observation: Compare standard schemes under the same BER threshold.
Show objective convergence and the resulting map.
Compare original and redesigned QAM BER-SNR curves.

figures.lesson: Keep schemes and threshold on a common logarithmic response axis.
Place convergence evidence beside the resulting topology.
Use matched axes for original and redesigned signal constellations.
Verify that geometric changes improve the target performance curve.

code_links.note: No independently packaged source tree was paired with this exact PDF; embedded appendix fragments are not treated as reproducible code.

transferable_rules.rule: Define a common operating threshold when comparing communication schemes.
Pair every optimization convergence curve with the actual decision structure it produced.
Use matched small multiples for before-after geometric designs.

risks.risk: The paper combines loosely coupled modulation and network-planning tasks, so the narrative is broad.
Only partial code appears in the appendix and cannot reproduce the reported network results.
Default MATLAB styling and small labels reduce print quality.
The award description remains unverified outside the repository mirror.

provenance.review_method: full-page render overview plus 4-7 high-resolution evidence-page visual checks and extracted-text review
